title: Correct Baseline to Bottleneck
summary: Start with a small obviously correct solution, then identify the repeated expensive work that prevents it from scaling.
recognition_signals: the correct solution repeats the same expensive search or computation
optimization must preserve the original contract
core_rules: Keep the trusted baseline long enough to compare behavior.
Optimize the repeated expensive operation rather than changing unrelated code.
structural_steps: write or identify the simplest correct baseline
name the operation repeated across many iterations
replace that repeated work with maintained or precomputed state
compare the optimized result against the baseline on small cases

common_confusions.distinction: This family is a workflow for moving from correctness to optimization. Complexity-by-operation is the analysis used to identify which repeated operation is actually expensive.
